parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The value of **ClientToken** can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: OssUrl
parameters.description: The OSS URL of the Skill compressed file to be detected.
